project.topic: What if every human on Earth jumped at the same time?
project.title: What if Every Human on Earth Jumped at the Same Time?
project.audience: International general audience; curious nontechnical science and documentary viewers
project.core_question: Could a synchronized human jump change Earth's orbit, and what would actually matter?
project.viewer_takeaway: Humanity is about twelve trillion times less massive than Earth. Internal jumping cannot boost the Earth-human system's orbit; a concentrated crowd creates a much greater infrastructure problem.

scientific_model.baseline_reality: Use a fixed illustrative population of 8.2 billion (UN 2024 baseline), mean body mass 62 kg, Earth mass 5.9722e24 kg and g=9.81 m/s2. This is not a live 2026 population count.
scientific_model.counterfactual_change: Idealized perfectly synchronized 0.30 m center-of-mass jumps, first in one zone and then at normal home locations. All people being able to jump and safe crowd clearance are counterfactual assumptions.
assumptions: Population 8.2e9 and assumed mean mass 62 kg: total 5.084e11 kg.
Jump height 0.30 m, takeoff speed sqrt(2gh)=2.43 m/s, flight time 0.495 s.
Use an isolated Earth-human system during the brief jump, subtracting common solar free fall.
Five people per square metre gives 1640 km2 of bodies alone. This dangerous density cannot provide safe real jumping space; roads and infrastructure would require additional area.
Aerial crowds show representative blocks; schematics and recoil are explicitly not to scale.
causal_chain: Earth/human mass ratio 1.175e13, approximately twelve trillion.
At apex, terrestrial recoil is Mh/(Me+Mh)*0.30 = 2.55e-14 m, about 25 femtometres. This is larger than a proton, but approximately 4000 times smaller than a representative 1e-10 m atom.
In the isolated model the system center of mass stays fixed. Landing reverses the relative displacement; there is no orbital propulsion.
Landing potential energy Mh*g*h = 1.50e12 J, distributed over the crowd and dissipated into tissue, shoes, surface deformation, heat, sound and seismic vibration.
No reliable single earthquake magnitude or sound level follows from total energy alone; coupling, coherence, geometry and ground response are unknown.
Concentrating the population overwhelms water, transport and medical capacity; distributed jumps give differently directed impulses and additional partial vector cancellation.
uncertainties: The 62 kg mean body mass is an illustrative assumption, not a measured current global total.
Seismic coupling, synchronization, local geology and acoustic propagation are unspecified; no quantitative quake magnitude or decibel prediction is made.
Human populations are unevenly distributed, so opposing radial impulses do not cancel exactly.
The film assumes a leap is possible and shows representative spacing; the 1640 km2 estimate includes only tightly packed bodies.

claims.statement: Humanity has approximately 5.1e11 kg mass; Earth is approximately twelve trillion times more massive.
claims.presentation_guardrail: 62 kg is assumed. Label diagrams not to scale.

claims.statement: A concentrated 30 cm jump produces approximately 2.55e-14 m recoil, far smaller than an atom; the system center of mass receives no orbital boost.
claims.reasoning: Center-of-mass balance: deltaEarth = -Mh/(Me+Mh)*h. NIST proton radius is 0.84 fm, so the original less-than-a-proton comparison is false.
claims.presentation_guardrail: Use atom, not proton, comparison; show exaggerated motion and no orbital boost in isolated model.

claims.statement: Total landing potential energy is approximately 1.5 trillion joules.
claims.presentation_guardrail: Distributed low-speed impacts; sound rings are illustrative, not destructive shock fronts.

claims.statement: The impact is cushioned; total energy does not establish a particular earthquake magnitude.
claims.reasoning: Unknown energy coupling and spatial coherence preclude a unique seismic prediction; USGS distinguishes radiated energy, magnitude and intensity.
claims.presentation_guardrail: Synthetic instrument trace, no magnitude label, collapse or cracking.

claims.statement: At five people per square metre, bodies alone occupy 1640 km2; concentrating humanity creates a severe supply and transport problem.
claims.reasoning: 8.2e9 / 5 / 1e6 = 1640 km2; excludes all infrastructure and safe movement space.
claims.presentation_guardrail: Label density as dangerous and body-area only; logistics scenes are illustrative.

claims.statement: At home locations, differently directed radial impulses partly cancel; internal jumping still provides no orbital propulsion.
claims.reasoning: Vector addition of radial impulses, not exact cancellation for uneven populations; conservation of total system momentum.
claims.presentation_guardrail: Schematic arrows; actual population is uneven.

sources.name: UN World Population Prospects 2024, Summary of Results (8.2 billion baseline)
NIST CODATA 2022 proton charge radius; correction to supplied proton comparison
USGS Earthquake Magnitude, Energy Release, and Shaking Intensity

creative_direction.logline: One synchronized jump barely recoils the planet; getting humanity into and out of one crowded city is the real problem.
creative_direction.visual_identity: Tactile urban documentary realism paired with crisp physics-lab schematics: sunlit city crosswalks, slow-motion footfalls with golden acoustic shock-rings, precision brass instruments, and NASA-textured orbital views.
creative_direction.lighting: Crisp late-morning urban sunlight with long architectural shadows for the city jump scenes, contrasted with clean studio key lighting for schematic physics stages and high-contrast orbital sunlight in space.
creative_direction.camera_language: Dynamic ground-level tracking shots for the synchronized leap, locked-off macro instrumentation for the seismometer and gauges, and sweeping aerial/orbital pullbacks to reveal crowd scale.
creative_direction.motion_language: Deterministic analytical trajectories: parabolic vertical jump arcs, expanding circular sound rings, damped sinusoidal seismometer traces, and smooth orbital rotation.
creative_direction.world_scale_policy: Urban shots use metres; body-area, mass and atomic-scale recoil diagrams are explicitly schematic and not to scale.
emotional_arc: Instant visceral intrigue as an entire city avenue leaps in unison
Perspective shift as Earth's 12-trillion-fold mass advantage is revealed
Understand center-of-mass conservation and an atomic-scale recoil.
Sensory awe at the 1.5-trillion-joule acoustic roar and modest seismic trace
Thoughtful surprise that the real danger is logistically stranding 8 billion people in one city
creative_direction.opening_hook: A low street view shows a synchronized 30 cm leap, clean shoe clearance and illustrative landing rings.
creative_direction.ending_payoff: Return from serene Earth to the opening street, ending on the same resting crowd pose and camera.
creative_direction.loop_connection: Scene S09 ends at the exact street-level camera position, lighting, and crowd phase where Scene S01 begins its synchronized jump.
creative_direction.asset_policy: Maximize reuse of registered assets: city-street-block-v1, pedestrian-crowd-v1, humanoid-figure-v1, sound-rings-v1, seismometer-v1, dial-gauge-v1, earth-globe-v1, starfield-v1, sky-dome-v1, port-diorama-kit-v1, apartment-facade-v1, clinic-interior-v1, and wpp2024-world-graphics-v1.

audio.voice_style: Calm, peaceful, warm adult male; intimate documentary voice; natural breathing; wonder without shouting
audio.music_direction: Rhythmic, minimalist documentary score using audio-synth-kit-v1: a poised marimba-and-sub-bass countdown pulse in D minor that suspends weightlessly during the jump apex, drops with a warm low-end thud on landing, and resolves into an airy, contemplative harmonic pad.
audio.sfx_direction: Clean, physical Foley and synth textures: synchronized crowd crouch rustle, brief airborne hush, deep stadium-like landing thud and rolling acoustic roar, subtle seismometer stylus scratch, and quiet urban gridlock ambience.

captions.style: Two-line balanced captions with dark translucent backdrop pill, Inter Bold, active-word yellow.
captions.active_word_treatment: High-contrast solar-yellow fill (#FACC15) on the active word with a subtle 4% scale lift.
captions.highlights_policy: Emphasize at most one key quantitative or causal phrase per clause using exact substring matches from caption_emphasis.

scenes.visual_payoff: Along a sunlit city avenue, dozens of articulated pedestrians crouch in unison, launch 30 cm into the air, and slam down together as golden acoustic wave rings ripple across the street.

narration.delivery_note: Immediate, poised intrigue; slight rhythmic lift on 'jumped at once?'.

scenes.visual_payoff: An orbital view and a 3D schematic mass comparison reveal that 8.2 billion humans (~500 million tons) are outweighed by Earth nearly 12 trillion times over.

narration.text: Eight billion people weigh five hundred million tons. Earth is twelve trillion times more massive.
narration.delivery_note: Warm authority on 'five hundred million tons', then quiet amazement on 'twelve trillion times'.
